# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_85/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_85/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_85/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_85/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_85_2 and Source3_85_0 on County
df_join1 = pd.merge(source2, source0, on="County", how="inner")

# Join the above result with Source3_85_3 on County
df_join2 = pd.merge(df_join1, source3, on="County", how="inner")

# Group by County and m1401 (primary key columns) to ensure uniqueness and match target keys
df_final = df_join2.groupby(["County", "m1401"], as_index=False).first()

# Select only the columns in the target schema and order them accordingly
df_final = df_final[["County", "m1401", "m1403"]]

# Write the final output
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_85/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
